name: Blue Lagoon
bestView: The north edge of the lagoon at sunset, steam drifting over the water with Mt. Þorbjörn behind
bestMonths: June to August for light, February to April for northern lights
crowd: Busy 11:00 to 16:00. Book the first or last slot of the day for near-empty water
kid: Kids 8+ love the floating mask bar and the algae mask ritual. Water is 38°C, safe for long soaks
adventure: Snorkelling the Silfra fissure (45 min away)
kidPicks: Floating pizza delivery in the water
priceNote: Iceland is expensive. The lagoon itself is the big ticket; eat lunch at a bakery, not the hotel.

visa.note: Schengen visa if required; 90 days in any 180 across the whole zone.
